research_hypotheses.claim: Moderate anthropomorphic cues may improve perceived empathy and trust, but visual human-likeness alone is not assumed to improve conversion or satisfaction.
research_hypotheses.source: Ma et al., Frontiers in Computer Science, 2025, doi:10.3389/fcomp.2025.1531976

research_hypotheses.claim: Highly human-like or over-expressive avatars may create uncanniness or insincerity, so a clearly-digital treatment remains a first-class candidate.
research_hypotheses.source: Frontiers in Psychology systematic review, 2025, doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2025.1625984

research_hypotheses.claim: Speech rate and intonation are experimental variables because paralinguistic delivery can affect attraction and social perception.
research_hypotheses.source: Evoking trust in smart voice assistants, 2026

research_hypotheses.claim: Repeated personalized interactions can change trust, perceived relevance, privacy perceptions and adherence, so persona learning must be longitudinal and scope-bound.
research_hypotheses.source: Computers in Human Behavior: Artificial Humans, 2024, doi:10.1016/j.chbah.2023.100030
